description:
Search

Polymorphic read-only search across your Vruum workspace.

One tool for every list/queue/search read. Pass `type` to pick the entity:
people (your pipeline — keyword `query`, batch dedup array, or list-mode
`filters`), companies (company-domain contact search for decision-makers —
requires filters.domain), directory_people (the shared people directory —
requires filters.query), and directory_companies (the shared company directory —
filters.query?, filters.industry?, or both; industry is the canonical enum,
including Unspecified for missing source data). Directory results contain
contact/company/freshness fields only, never another tenant's CRM state.
Other types are deals, objectives, messages (outreach queue), engagements
(LinkedIn engagement queue), content (LinkedIn content calendar), claims
(the hypothesis ledger: falsifiable beliefs with evidence-backed
confidence — filter by status or scope; render one with fetch
type='claim'), kb
(knowledge-base search), skills (published skills), cta_links, warm_paths
(open targets that have a warm intro path — see find_warm_path for one
target), relationship_attempts (the durable action timeline shared with
the Relationships workspace).

All types except `companies` read internal, tenant-scoped data only.
Pagination (`limit`/`offset`) is supported for people (list mode), deals,
messages, engagements, warm_paths, and relationship_attempts; other types reject it. Results are returned
under `{type, results}` with each entity type's native payload shape.

Objective routing: use `type='objectives'` here to list objectives
(newest-moved first; filters.status, filters.mirror). To read one
objective by UUID with its live pins and members count, use `fetch` with
`type='objective'`. To create, update, clone, retire, pause, launch, or
manage objective members, use `manage_outreach`. A paused objective must
pass forecast review and launch approval before it becomes active again.

### Responses:

**200**: Successful Response (Success Response)
Content-Type: application/json

anyOf.description:
List-mode filters for ``type='people'`` (routes to ``get_user_people``).

Mutually exclusive with ``query`` — pass one or the other, never both.

account_list.description: Comma-separated account list UUIDs. Only people with a known employer in any selected list.
account_list.title: Account List

custom.description: Custom-attribute filters from CSV-import custom columns; every key=value pair must match (e.g. {'sorted_company_size': 'small'}).
custom.title: Custom

enrollment.description: Outreach enrollment filter: all, enrolled, paused, not_enrolled.
enrollment.title: Enrollment

list.description: Only people in this list — people_lists UUID or exact name (CSV-import list mirroring). Unknown list returns an empty result.
list.title: List

objective.description: Objective UUID, exact name, 'unassigned' for people with no live objective membership, or a comma-separated UUID list to combine several objectives.
objective.title: Objective

persona.description: Buying-center role filter: initiator, user, champion, decider, gatekeeper, influencer, executive_buyer, approver, purchaser, unknown, or 'unclassified' (no classification run yet).
persona.title: Persona

relationship_type.description: Relationship filter: outbound_prospect, inbound_buyer, inbound_seller, networking, or all.
relationship_type.title: Relationship Type

research_status.description: 'researched', 'shallow', 'deep', 'stub', or 'all'. When omitted, matches the underlying endpoint's default: 'researched' for browsing, but 'all' when `search` is set (a search must find stubs too).
research_status.title: Research Status

search.description: Free-text search across email, first/last name, title, company name.
search.title: Search

sort_by.description: Sort by recent, score, name, or company (default: score — same as the underlying endpoint).
sort_by.title: Sort By

stage.description: Pipeline stage: new, warming, enrolled, contacted, replied, met, opportunity, closed_won, closed_lost.
stage.title: Stage

anyOf.title: FacadePeopleFilters

seniority.description: Seniority filter: executive (C-level/VP), senior (directors/managers), or junior.
seniority.title: Seniority

outcome.description: Deal outcome filter: won, lost, stalled.
outcome.title: Outcome

query.description: Free-text search for a specific deal — case-insensitive, every whitespace-separated word must match. Spans the deal name, the associated company name, and the primary contact's name/email/title. Combine with stage/outcome to scope further.
query.title: Query

stage.description: Deal stage filter. Matches the deal's pipeline-stage label LITERALLY (exact, case-sensitive string — not a closed enum). Native pipelines use met, qualified, proposal, negotiation, verbal_yes, closed_won, closed_lost; HubSpot-imported pipelines carry their own custom labels (e.g. 'Hot Leads', 'Prospecting', 'Trial Signup', 'Closed lost'). Pass the literal label exactly as stored. Discover the labels a tenant's pipeline actually uses via inspect_pipeline (groups deals by stage) or by listing deals (with no stage filter) and reading each deal's 'stage'.
stage.title: Stage

anyOf.description:
Filters for ``type='objectives'`` (routes to ``list_objectives``,
filtered client-side — the underlying route has no server-side filter or
projection).

mirror.description: true = only campaign-mirror objectives (objectives.mirror); false = only native objectives; omit for both.
mirror.title: Mirror

status.description: Objective status filter. list_objectives already excludes retired objectives at the source, so status='retired' returns nothing.
status.title: Status

anyOf.title: FacadeObjectivesFilters

fields.description: Set to 'compact' for a lightweight projection WITHOUT message body — keeps message_id, person_name, category, sequence_number, channel, status, match_score (the person's latest fit score) and match_scored_at (the day it was made; score_min/score_max match only scores whose research still holds), touches_completed, objective_id, first_content_touch, channel_rewrite_reason, expires_at, connection_status. first_content_touch=true = the person has never received a content-bearing message (connection requests don't count): treat the item as an OPENER regardless of sequence_number; null = row predates the conversation_state brief (fall back to the sequence_number heuristic). expires_at (needs_draft rows only) = when the nightly sweep auto-rejects the row if still unauthored (regenerate grants a fresh window) — author nearest-deadline-first (sort_by=expiring) to beat it. connection_status = the linked plan's LinkedIn connection state: a linkedin_message row with connection_status='connected' is a WARM follow-up (they accepted the invite) — dispatch these first. Cheap on tokens for triage. An unrecognized value 422s.
fields.title: Fields

has_reply.description: Only messages that have (true) / have not (false) received a reply.
has_reply.title: Has Reply

message_type.description: Row family (VRU-832). Omit or 'outreach' for outbound touches (default, unchanged). 'inbound' lists received replies — reply text in content, receive time in created_at, status 'received' (no actionable-status default applies); combine with category='person_reply' to exclude unsolicited inbound. 'manual' lists operator one-off sends — Vruum manual sends and provider-observed external sends (typed directly in LinkedIn/Gmail), status 'sent', no actionable-status default. 'all' returns all three families.
message_type.title: Message Type

objective_id.description: Objective UUID, or '__none__' for rows authored outside any objective. Filters the message's AUTHORING objective — not the person's current objective membership.
objective_id.title: Objective Id

person_id.description: Filter by a specific person ID.
person_id.title: Person Id

search.description: Search across subject, person email, person name.
search.title: Search

sort_by.description: Sort: recent (default), expiring (created_at asc — nearest sweep deadline first, pair with status='needs_draft'), person_name, subject, priority, or match_score.
sort_by.title: Sort By

status.description: Message status: needs_draft (unauthored — author via manage_messages edit), draft, approved, rejected, sent (expands to post-send statuses), or all. Omit for default (needs_draft + draft + approved).
status.title: Status

view.description: Set to 'breakdown' for a queue-composition summary: grouped counts (by objective × category × sequence × channel × status, plus per-dimension marginals) over the full matching set, alongside a compact items page. Implies fields='compact'. An unrecognized value 422s.
view.title: View

warm_only.description: true = only WARM follow-ups: linkedin_message rows whose plan has connection_status='connected' (the person ACCEPTED the connection request — highest-EV rows in the queue). Forces channel=linkedin_message. warm_only=true + status='needs_draft' + sort_by='expiring' pulls the warm authoring lane in one call, nearest sweep deadline first.
warm_only.title: Warm Only

objective.description: Objective name or UUID used to filter authored engagement rows.
objective.title: Objective

source.description: Engagement source: comment_reply, warming, nurture, or marketing.
source.title: Source

status.description: Engagement status: draft, approved, sent, failed, skipped.
status.title: Status

days.description: Number of days of calendar history to show (default 14 — same as the underlying endpoint).
days.title: Days

doc_type.description: Filter by type: positioning, case_study, objection_handling, battlecard, process, other (authored docs), or 'connector' for synced Drive/Notion documents only. Omit to search both.
doc_type.title: Doc Type

document_id.description: Fetch full content of one document (ignores query/doc_type). Accepts an authored-doc UUID or a connector id of the form '<connection_uuid>:<source_record_id>' (as returned in search results).
document_id.title: Document Id

include_content.description: Include full document text in search results (default false for a compact catalog). Connector docs return snippets in search mode regardless; read one in full via document_id.
include_content.title: Include Content

modified_after.description: ISO-8601 timestamp (no offset = UTC); requires doc_type='connector'. Returns only synced documents modified strictly after this instant — with no query, ordered newest-first. Use this (NOT a keyword query, which is a relevance-ranked top-N sample) for exhaustive 'what synced since <date>' discovery, e.g. finding new meeting transcripts past a watermark.
modified_after.title: Modified After

query.description: Fuzzy keyword search. Matches authored docs (name/summary/keywords, typo-tolerant) AND synced connector documents (Google Drive / Notion) by title + body — e.g. meeting transcripts.
query.title: Query

anyOf.description: Filters for ``type='skills'`` (routes to the MCP ``list_skills`` route).

scope.description: Skill scope filter: private, company, or operator. Omit for every scope the caller can see.
scope.title: Scope

anyOf.title: FacadeSkillsFilters

anyOf.description:
Filters for ``type='cta_links'`` (routes to ``get_cta_links``).

The underlying endpoint takes no filters and no pagination — this model is
intentionally empty (pagination on ``cta_links`` is rejected at the
request level, never silently ignored).
anyOf.title: FacadeCtaLinksFilters

anyOf.description: Filters for durable web/MCP relationship actions.
anyOf.title: FacadeRelationshipAttemptsFilters

anyOf.description: Shared people-directory lookup, with no tenant-private fields.

query.description: Name, title, company, or email search text.
query.title: Query

anyOf.title: FacadeDirectoryPeopleFilters

anyOf.description: Shared company-directory lookup by text, canonical industry, or both.
Canonical research values plus the fallback bucket used by search.
anyOf.title: SearchableIndustry

industry.description: Canonical company-industry filter. Unspecified selects companies without enough source data. Provider labels such as SaaS are rejected.

query.description: Optional company name, domain, or website search text.
query.title: Query

anyOf.title: FacadeDirectoryCompaniesFilters

anyOf.description:
Filters for ``type='claims'`` (routes to ``list_claims`` — the VRU-840
hypothesis ledger).

company_id.description: Claims scoped to this company UUID.
company_id.title: Company Id

deal_id.description: Claims scoped to this deal UUID.
deal_id.title: Deal Id

exclude_retired.description: Drop retired (superseded) claims so live claims are never crowded out.
exclude_retired.title: Exclude Retired

kind.description: Claim kind in scope, e.g. 'observed_conversion' for the loop's measurements.
kind.title: Kind

objective_id.description: Claims scoped to this objective UUID.
objective_id.title: Objective Id

person_id.description: Claims scoped to this person UUID.
person_id.title: Person Id

segment.description: Claims scoped to this named segment.
segment.title: Segment

surface.description: Claims on this surface, e.g. 'positioning_diagnostic' for the viability claim set (VRU-846).
surface.title: Surface

anyOf.title: FacadeClaimsFilters

filters.description: Type-specific filters — the object shape is determined by `type` (e.g. {domain} for companies, {stage, outcome, query} for deals, or {query?, industry?} for directory_companies). Unknown keys are rejected with 422.
filters.title: filters

for_company.description: Optional company ID or name (UUID, or case-insensitive EXACT name match — partial / substring matches are NOT supported; ambiguous names raise 400) to execute this tool as. Use get_operator_companies, or get_operator_overview with view='companies', to list available companies. Only needed if you manage multiple companies. Access is enforced server-side: the tool resolves the value to a user_company_id and verifies the caller's membership in `company_users` — a 403 'Company not found or access denied' means EITHER the value did not match a known company OR the caller is not a member of it. The MCP operator role itself is NOT auto-granted — operators get this access by being members of each client company via `company_users` (the same row that grants any normal user access).
for_company.title: for_company

limit.description: Page size. Supported for people, deals, messages, warm_paths, and relationship_attempts (max 100), engagements (max 200), and directory searches (max 40); people keyword-query mode caps at 40. Rejected (422) for other types.
limit.title: limit

offset.description: Pagination offset. Supported for people (list mode), deals, messages, engagements, warm_paths, and relationship_attempts. Rejected (422) for other types and for people query mode.
offset.title: offset

items.description: One candidate in a people batch lookup (maps to ``BatchSearchRequest.queries``).

company.description: Company name to look up alongside the person name.
company.title: Company

linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL — strongest dedup signal; exact-matched first when present.
linkedin_url.title: Linkedin Url

name.description: Person full name to look up in the existing pipeline.
name.title: Name

items.title: FacadeBatchPersonQuery

query.description: Only for type='people'. A keyword string searches the existing pipeline (name/title/company); an array of {name?, company?, linkedin_url?} objects runs a batch dedup lookup (results in original order). Mutually exclusive with `filters`. For type='kb' or type='deals', use filters.query instead.
query.title: query

type.description: The relationship-aware entity types the ``search`` facade can read.
type.title: type
